Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. A couple of quick clarifications from security so we can map evidence to our checklist: 

- SOC 2: do you provide the full Type II report or a redacted summary? We usually require the full auditor report under NDA.
- Pen test: is the most recent test third-party (independent) or a vendor-conducted internal test? If independent, can you share scope and date (network vs application)?
- Audit logs / retention: we need retention windows (system logs, request logs, admin activity) and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM.
- Data residency: confirmation of EU/US regions and any cross-region failover that replicates data — we need to capture this for the DPA.

If you can provide the SOC 2 report and a short answers doc for the above items, we can pass to legal/procurement (Lara) and map to an internal security signoff by 02/24.

Thanks,
Tom Rogers
Head of Security
Finexa
Tom.Rogers@finexa.com

Tom — thanks for the list. Answers below and attaching the SOC 2 Type II (redwood_soc2_report_2024.pdf). If you want an NDA before the full auditor report, let us know and Marissa will coordinate.

- SOC 2: We are attaching our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PII sections removed). We can provide the full auditor report under a standard NDA — let me know and Marissa will send.
- Pen test: Latest penetration test was completed by an independent third-party (BlueWave Security) on 2025-11-05. Scope covered application-layer + infra; we can provide the executive summary and scope. Alex will attach the pen-test executive summary by EOD.
- Audit logs / retention:
   - System and request logs retained for 365 days by default.
   - Admin activity logs retained for 2 years.
   - Logs can be exported to customer-owned S3 or delivered via secure transfer for SIEM ingestion (S3 bucket/role with scoped read access).
- Data residency: Redwood hosts instances in both us-west-2 and eu-west-1. For Finexa we recommend provisioning in us-west-2; cross-region failover only occurs if configured — data is not automatically replicated across regions unless requested.

Mutual action plan (attached MAP-v1.xlsx):
